name: Rejected Status Reason 9 Code
definition: Reason for which an instruction, request, report message is rejected.

DSEC.name: Financial Instrument Identification
DSEC.definition: Identification of the security is not recognised or is invalid.

IDNA.name: Financial Instrument Identification And Name
IDNA.definition: Identification of the security and the security name are not the same.

ORRF.name: Duplicate Order Reference
ORRF.definition: Order reference is a duplicate of a previously received order.

NSLA.name: Not Compliant With SLA
NSLA.definition: Instruction is not compliant with the service level agreement.

NCRR.name: Settlement Amount Currency
NCRR.definition: Unrecognised or invalid Settlement Amount Currency.

PLCE.name: Place Of Trade
PLCE.definition: Unrecognised or invalid Place of Trade.

DTRD.name: Trade Date
DTRD.definition: Unrecognised or invalid trade date or requested trade date or future trade date.
